horoscope: Today's Venus-Neptune transit can introduce some cause for hesitation or pause, dear Aries. A small bump in the road or a temporary dip in your confidence can slow you down and help you reorient. Try not to let empathy override your common sense, as you may tend to see what you want to see. Nevertheless, you may feel slightly out of sync with others, and the temptation might be to compensate by going out of your way to make them happy. It may be better to focus on understanding your own needs rather than spending time and draining your energy trying to figure out what others want. Resolve outstanding issues if they've weighed you down, even if it is just taking one or two steps toward your goals. The Moon moves into your privacy sector today, and there's a real need to enjoy some downtime.

You're in a generally favorable period for harmony in close relationships, dear Taurus, although there can be some conflict stirred up to get to a purer level of peace. Today, things you've swept under the carpet can surface in small but palpable ways. While your spirits are generally good today, it's not the best time to see your relationships clearly. As well, you can easily get into a position where you're doing so much for others that you feel a bit drained. If you've held onto a fantasy about a relationship or situation, it may now cause minor problems. You may feel discomfort around your deeper emotions, attractions, and attachments. If so, you might consider it a signal to give your heart a little more time on a matter. Patience will serve you best right now.

The Moon heads to the top of your solar chart today, dear Gemini, and your priorities come strongly to mind. Still, with today's transits, there can be confusing impressions and sensitivities or a feeling of being overwhelmed. It's a time to reevaluate matters and allow yourself more time, not to drop or abandon a pursuit. A minor challenge between Venus and Neptune can prompt you to prioritize keeping the peace and maintaining harmony today. It's best not to go overboard with this, or else you could end up feeling misunderstood or unappreciated. You could instead feel let down by a broken promise. Don't worry too much if you are a little out of sync with others or with your goals, as it's temporary. Look into ways to infuse more meaning, pleasure, or imagination into your work or chores. If you find yourself restlessly indulging or craving things, it may be that you need to get in better touch with your needs.

The Moon moves into your solar ninth house today, dear Cancer, and emotional expression comes more naturally to you. Still, there is some tendency to see a situation the wrong way, especially if it's too close to your heart, with Venus and Neptune in an awkward aspect. Wishful thinking can blur perceptions, particularly related to romance, business, and long-term planning. You are unlikely to feel sure about making a significant commitment or decision, so it may be better to avoid overcompensating for your uncertainty and instead make time for rest or a time-out. Consider that staying in a state of indecision over largely trivial matters can sometimes drain you of more energy than dealing with the consequences of a decision! Try to focus on what you feel good about doing and tune out what others think or say as much as possible. After all, a temporary dip in motivation or spirits can be useful for realigning yourself.

Matters of the heart are not very straightforward today, dear Leo. Not only is there a tendency for people to be indirect, but sensitivity also runs high. There can be some division due to uncertainty, which can leave you in an ambivalent state socially. These days, you seek more peace and familiarity with Venus transiting your solar fourth house. However, the desire to do something different or unusual is strong, and is often healthy, but your heart isn't all in just for now. Try not to stay on the fence for too long. You might find that staying in limbo is more draining than simply making a decision and living with it. There's no use wasting energy worrying about the little things. For the big stuff, however, it's best to wait things out.

In spots today, you could be feeling discontent on a social level, dear Virgo. However, not knowing your heart today may tempt you to avoid the truth in your relationships. It's probably better to admit uncertainty and move on for now. Otherwise, you could end up only spinning your wheels. There could be unspoken desires or a sense that you want something but can't put your finger on what it is. Try not to let distractions like these bring you down. Aim to take more time to get in touch with your needs. It's a better time to keep things status quo than to push ahead. It probably won't pay to make waves if confidence is dipping, or you don't have all the tools you need to manage a situation. This is temporary and can help you reorient yourself.

With the Moon's move into your work and health sector today, dear Libra, you're focusing on the practical side of life. Even so, there can be odd desires or cravings that seem to come out of nowhere today, along with a sense that you shouldn't indulge. Today's transits may seem to tempt you to escape responsibility, hide things about yourself, or appease when you should probably stand up for yourself. Still, the timing isn't ideal, so if you are uncertain, ride it out until you are clearer. Yearnings can be hard to pinpoint just for now. Keep watch for a tendency to focus on everything except what deserves your attention! Superficial attempts to make yourself feel better are unlikely to satisfy, and may even cost valuable time and energy, and possibly money.

Desires can be sudden or unusual today, dear Scorpio. Today's Venus-Neptune quincunx makes it a fuzzy, uncertain time for decisions about love and money. Take care of yourself rather than doing everything for everyone else and forgetting what you need in the process. Avoid people-pleasing as a quick fix for achieving the peace and harmony you crave. Instead, aim to dream and let your intuition guide you. Self-doubt or confusion is temporary, but you should probably avoid speculation, significant purchases or sales, and big decisions in the meantime.

While you can begin the day feeling rather interactive and craving connectivity, dear Sagittarius, as the day advances, it can become clear that you need some relaxation. Part of you may be afraid of letting go of a fantasy or ideal today, however, but unrealistic expectations can lead to discomfort. Vague dissatisfaction can weave in and out today. Sudden needs that don't make much sense are probably leading you astray right now. Aim to connect with your true needs or work on your happiness rather than looking to others to bring you joy. Accepting things for what they are and appreciating them is the key now. A temporary lull can also slow you down long enough to explore alternate routes. After a brief spell of feeling doubtful or unmotivated, you'll find it easy to tune out the non-essential.

On an emotional or sentimental level, dear Capricorn, today's transits may sometimes leave you with a feeling that you're not getting what you want. Try to address the root of the problem, but if you can't get to it, it may be wise to avoid going off on tangents. Still, aim to avoid lingering in limbo for too long today, especially over small problems. Rest and reflect when you can, or consider focusing on one special task at a time. For the best results, avoid brand new beginnings, making waves, or essential decisions until confidence returns and timing improves.

The Moon leaves your sign today, moving into your solar second house for a stay of over two days, dear Aquarius, and turns your attention to what makes you comfortable and secure. Even so, transits today can make it challenging to be as productive as you'd like. Venus at the top of your chart these days generally points to greater enjoyment of your work or duties, but times like today may require a break from performing. You might agree to something to please someone, then later regret that you weren't straightforward. There can be benefits through your work or benefits from others, but you might find that it costs too much, in the long run, to yield to others at the moment. Watch for misconceptions today. Circumstances seem to test your vulnerabilities, but you can move beyond this, or you get the chance to sort everything out to your advantage later.

Social or emotional distractions make it difficult to focus your energy at times today, dear Pisces. It's not easy to see how you can practically manage everything you'd like to do, or perhaps even where to begin. If you feel a little let down, or in a frump, it may be that you need some emotional refreshment. There can be vague problems or disconnects that may leave you feeling somewhat out of sync. Some confusion about money, resources, or know-how can subtly get in the way of personal enjoyment or the pursuit of a new interest. Today is more about winding down than pushing something forward. A bit of hesitation can help you find yourself. No matter how small or big your plans and ideas are right now, don't rush to put them into action until you feel fully confident.
